texts.zh: 载有大量[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]难民的运输船从[marauder_neighbor.GetName]方向进入了我们的领域。他们肯定是被人从一个个残破的空间站—那些他们曾称之为家园的地方赶出来了，大概是因为资源有限而采取的控制人口的措施。已经允许他们在[Root.GetName]安定下来。
texts.en: Transports carrying a large number of [marauder_neighbor_species.GetName] refugees have crossed into our space from the direction of the [marauder_neighbor.GetName]. These exiles have apparently been expelled from the decrepit space stations they once called home in some sort of ritual, designed to act as a means of population control in times of limited resources. They have been allowed to settle on [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 与[marauder_neighbor.GetName]持续不断的边境冲突磨炼了我们的部队。他们的能力在实战中得到了锻炼，他们甚至学到了[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]的作战技巧，这肯定能在以后的战斗中给他们带来优势。
texts.en: An extended period of unrelenting border skirmishes with the [marauder_neighbor.GetName] has hardened our serving naval crews. Their abilities have been tempered in battle, and our forces have even adopted several complex [marauder_neighbor_species.GetName] combat maneuvers that will give them an edge in future conflicts.

texts.zh:
与[marauder_neighbor.GetName]在我们的边境上经历了长久的冲突之后，我们的[root.GetIndividualName]群似乎已经发展出了一定程度的自主能力。现在能够自动反制[marauder_neighbor_species.GetNamePlural]不可预料的战法的能力。

当然，在机群发展出具有威胁性的单体作战能力之前必须得到前档处置，但是目前来看，这只会使得我们在短期内可预见的冲突中占尽优势。
texts.en:
After a prolonged period of skirmishing with the [marauder_neighbor.GetName] along our border, the [root.GetIndividualName] crews of our vessels seem to have developed a certain degree of initiative. They are now more capable of countering the often unpredictable tactics employed by the [marauder_neighbor_species.GetNamePlural].

This will eventually have to be dealt with before the crews develop a dangerous level of individuality, but for now it will give us an advantage in any future engagements.

texts.zh:
我们的作战单位在与[marauder_neighbor.GetName].经历了长久的冲突之后，被迫对编程做出一些更改，以应对[marauder_neighbor_species.GetNamePlural]不可预料的战法。

当然，这种新的数据最终还是要被清除的，不然系统会衰退。但是目前来看，这确实能够使得我们在短期可预见的冲突中占尽优势。
texts.en:
The efficiency of our naval units has increased after a prolonged period of border skirmishing with the [marauder_neighbor.GetName]. Our units have been forced to make slight alterations to their programming to make up for the unorthodox and unpredictable tactics employed by the [marauder_neighbor_species.GetNamePlural].

It will eventually become necessary to purge this new data to prevent system degradation in other areas, but for now it will give us an advantage in future engagements.

texts.zh: 最近在[marauder_neighbor.GetName]的两个军团的交战之后，有一个[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]逃生舱进入了我们的宇域。边境巡逻队截获了这个逃生舱，打开后发现是一位[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]指挥官，这位司令官愿意无偿为我们效忠至死。
texts.en: A [marauder_neighbor_species.GetName] escape pod drifted into our space recently, after a particularly violent clash between two warring clans of the [marauder_neighbor.GetName]. Border patrol units intercepted the pod and opened it, revealing a grateful [marauder_neighbor_species.GetName] flag officer. The Commander has pledged to serve us until death, at no cost.

label.zh: 我们不需要新的指挥官了。
label.en: We have no need of another Commander.

label.zh: 将这堆肉块施加安乐死。
至死方休？很好，拖出去净化了。
label.en: Until death it is. Dispose of the xeno.

label.zh: 把整个舱丢进我们的合金熔炉。
label.en: Throw the whole pod into our alloy smelter.

texts.zh:
一小队废弃的[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]战舰最近在[border_system.GetName]星系被我方发现，此处离[marauder_neighbor.GetName]的领土不远。舰船上的计算机日志显示，船员为了躲避某种形式的部族血斗逃入了我国境内。不幸的是，他们并没有携带足够的补给品，并很快因为饥饿导致全灭。这些舰船从此就在太空中漂浮。

我们的工程师检查了这些舰船，它们依然处于良好的状态。只要配备船员，这些舰船可以立马进入我们的舰队中服役。
texts.en:
A small fleet of derelict [marauder_neighbor_species.GetName] warships was recently discovered in the [border_system.GetName] system, not far from the territory of the [marauder_neighbor.GetName]. Computer logs on the ships indicate that their crews fled into our space to escape some kind of clan feud. Unfortunately for them, they brought few supplies and soon starved to death. The ships have been adrift ever since.

Our engineers have gone over the ships and they appear to be in decent condition. If they are crewed, we could commission them into service with our own fleet.

label.zh: 好，这些飞船还是有点价值的。
label.en: Yes, they could prove an asset.

label.zh: 不，这些东西都是垃圾。全都拆了。
label.en: No, those ships are space junk. Scrap them.

texts.zh:
机缘巧合之下，边境巡逻队最近在[border_system.GetName]星系发现了一个深藏在深空之中的资源贮存箱，其位置位于我方和[marauder_neighbor.GetName]的边境。这个超大的货箱里面装满了[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]劫掠收获的战利品，却在太空之中漂浮了几个世纪。

我们推断，大概是这个贮存箱被遗忘了，抑或是货箱的主人在另一场劫掠中或者是数不胜数的[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]内斗中被杀了。不管怎样，这里面的东西现在是我们的了。
texts.en:
By chance, patrol units recently discovered a hidden deep space resource cache in the [border_system.GetName] system, close to our border with the [marauder_neighbor.GetName]. The massive cargo containers of the cache contains spoils from several [marauder_neighbor_species.GetName] raids that must have been launched centuries ago.

At some point this cache was forgotten, or perhaps its owners were killed in another raid or one of the countless [marauder_neighbor_species.GetName] internecine feuds. In any event, its contents now belong to us.

texts.zh:
我们刚刚发现了一个半完成的[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]太空居住站遗迹，其位置位于[border_planet.GetName]，处于我国境内。很显然，过去某个时候[marauder_neighbor.GetName]尝试过在[border_system.GetName]星系建立一个永久居住站，然而由于某些原因这个设施被彻底的遗弃了。

由于其位置十分靠近[border_planet.GetName]，这座未完成的居住站在我方初次调查该星系的时候躲过了检测。现在这座居住地的状况比一堆太空垃圾好不了多少，但是我们依然能够从这堆残骸中发掘价值不菲的矿物。
texts.en:
We have discovered the remnants of a half-finished [marauder_neighbor_species.GetName] space habitat in close orbit around [border_planet.GetName], inside our borders. Evidently, at some point the [marauder_neighbor.GetName] attempted to establish a permanent presence in the [border_system.GetName] system, but for whatever reason this endeavour was abandoned.

Due to its close proximity to [border_planet.GetName], the unfinished habitat eluded detection during our initial survey of the system. It is little more than a dense collection of space junk at this point, but there are a lot of valuable minerals among the wreckage that could be salvaged.

texts.zh:
最近有一个[marauder_neighbor_species.GetName]飞行器在[border_system.GetName]恒星系进入了我方领域，当时它正被[marauder_neighbor.GetName]的突袭艇追赶着。我们不知道他们为什么被自己的人赶着跑，但是那些突袭艇遇到我们的边境守卫之后就撤退了。

这个损坏严重的飞行器之后被回收，我们发现上面的船员在进入[border_system.GetName]之后不久就死掉了。而它的货仓里满载了偷来的存有能量币的芯片。
texts.en:
A small [marauder_neighbor_species.GetName] shuttle recently crossed into our space in the [border_system.GetName] system, pursued by raiders from the [marauder_neighbor.GetName]. We are not certain why they were being chased by their own people, but the raiders withdrew when they were challenged by our border security.

The heavily damaged shuttle was recovered, revealing that the crew had perished shortly after they entered [border_system.GetName]. Its cargo hold was filled to the brim with stolen energy credit chips.

label.zh: 我们捞的，那就是我们的。
label.en: By right of salvage, the credits are ours.
